results.fact: Total elevation gain for the traverse
results.evidence: The contradiction is real: 2,900 ft is roughly the trail gain to Easy Pass alone (official figure 2,800 ft), and the route's own pins require 5,000+ ft just to reach Mesahchie. But published car-to-car totals differ a lot by style: a one-day Mesahchie-to-Cosho push reports about 8,000 ft over 15 miles (ending at Junction Camp, not the car), one climber logged 20,000 ft over two days, and a single-peak Katsuk trip logged 8,100 ft. No two sources agree on a car-to-car total for this route's itinerary, so no number was written.
